rdfs:label: ConceptScheme
rdfs:comment: A SKOS concept scheme — an aggregation of related Concepts, typically a thesaurus, taxonomy, or controlled vocabulary.
notes: The container for a controlled vocabulary. Concepts join via `urn:solid:inScheme`; the entry-point Concepts (no broader concept in this scheme) are listed via `urn:solid:hasTopConcept`. The IRI of the ConceptScheme itself is the canonical reference for the vocabulary as a whole. Not `urn:solid:Collection` (an ActivityStreams collection). For grouping concepts within a scheme use skos:Collection (http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Collection).

history.note: Added disambiguation against the ActivityStreams urn:solid:Collection.
